title: Iron Strike Ball First Then Turf (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, irons are different from drivers
Ball first then turf, thats the order
Divot in front of the ball, never behind

[Verse 1]
Ball in the center of the stance for mid irons
Shaft leans forward two degrees, hands ahead of clyrons
Weight slightly favors the lead side, fifty five forty five
Compress the ball, son, thats how irons thrive

[Pre-Chorus]
Descending blow, thats the iron way
Down and through, dont scoop or sway
Low point in front of the ball, two inches forward
Divot points target, never reward

[Chorus]
Iron strike ball first then turf, son
Divot toward the target, work begun
Hands ahead, shaft leaning forward two
Compress the ball, thats what irons do

[Verse 2]
Seven iron one fifty yards, thats the standard
One club difference each, ten yards under banner
Eight iron one forty, six iron one sixty
Know your numbers, son, thats how it gets sticky

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, dont try to lift the ball
The loft does the work, you just stand tall
Hit down to make it go up, son
Thats the iron paradox, the iron run

[Chorus]
Iron strike ball first then turf, son
Divot toward the target, work begun
Hands ahead, shaft leaning forward two
Compress the ball, thats what irons do

[Outro]
Ball first, turf second
Hands ahead, divot reckoned
Descending blow, thats the truth
Thats my boy, thats your proof
